senses.gloss: सु-हस- + आनन सु-हस- + आनन, adj. having a cheerfully smiling face.

† सुह् सुह्, (in signification 1, 2, for सुख्, q. cf.), i. 4, Par.
 1. To satisfy, to delight.
 2. To be pleased.
 3. To bear, to endure (cf. सह्).
सुहृत्ता सुहृत्ता, i. e. सु-हृद् + ता, f. Friendship.
सुह्म सुह्म, m. pl. Name of a people, Ragh. 4, 35.
सु- + हस्त्य सु- + हस्त्य, adj. clever, skilful, Chr. 290, 1 = Rigv. i. 64, 1.

सु- + हृद् सु- + हृद्,
 I. adj. loving, Pañc. i. d. 294; superl. सुहृत्तम, very fond (of each other), Hit. i. d. 1, M.M.
 II. m. 1. a friend, Vikr. 11, 13. 2. an ally.
सु- + हृदय सु- + हृदय, adj. good-hearted.
